## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      2 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 6, 2026 - Oct 13, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Madsmads01_, Oct 12, 2026, 1/5: "I’ve been trying to reach an actual human being to talk about cancelling my subscription for a week. I keep getting an automated message telling me the I have to cancel through the App Store but on the actual Finch app, they tell you that only the Finch team can handle cancellations and refunds. Why can’t I seem to reach an actual person for customer support. So ridiculous."
            2. _Seibzehn_, Sep 13, 2026, 2/5: "Finch initially makes a friendly and well thought-out impression. The concept can be particularly helpful for people who have difficulties with motivation, routines, procrastination or their general well-being. What I find all the more disappointing is the way they try to sell a subscription during onboarding. After you have just told the app in which personal areas you need support, an emotionally designed offer appears with statements such as “Biggest discount ever”, “One-time offer” and finally even “Offer expires when you exit this screen!”. I was offered a 50% discount and €39.99 per year instead of €79.99. The actual price and the automatic extension are stated transparently - that is not my criticism. What I find problematic is the artificial time pressure and the fear of losing a supposedly unique offer. With a regular app, aggressive paywall marketing would bother me. I find it particularly inappropriate for a self-care app. Ultimately, the target group can include people who are looking for support with ADHD, anxiety, depression, impulse control, motivation or self-organization. In my opinion, this is where you should handle FOMO and psychological selling pressure particularly responsibly. I would expressly not like to describe the app itself as dubious. I actually like the concept. However, for me, the type of marketing does not match the trusting and supportive claim of a self-care app. It would also be desirable to have a complete German translation of the app and a lifetime purchase option for users who deliberately do not want to take out another permanent subscription. I think a fair one-off payment would be very appropriate, especially for an app that is intended to help you build routines over the long term."
            3. _Mr. T-Wrecks_, Oct 13, 2026, 3/5: "I like the app. It has helped me stay focused and productive throughout the day. The only thing that really bothers me is the Shop items. If you’re a Free user, you only get 8 options in Outfit and Furniture to choose from (16 with the free re-roll). But the options are the worst options—they’re typically the most boring/generic options, and they follow the same pattern every time. All the good options require Finch Plus. Why? Free users are earning the same points in the same way as any user on Finch Plus. The items are already behind one “paywall” (in-game currency). Why put them behind two? Additionally, and maybe even more problematic, is that every item has multiple colors and each variation is a separate item. So if you see a hat you want but it’s in a color you don’t want, well, too bad. You’ll have to hope it comes up in the color you want. That is ridiculous. Just have the items and let us pick whatever color we want! The current way is designed to be exploitive—on a self-care app!"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 28, 2026 - Oct 11, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _plantguyhome_, May 28, 2026, 1/5: "I was so excited to use this app, even considered premium, but sadly my data gets lost every time after exiting the app for a while. This means everything is gone and I just get an apology over and over. For an app that’s meant to help people (especially ones with special conditions) this felt really frustrating to me and really killed my energy yesterday, as it has happened multiple times just yesterday. If I hatch a new pet I DON’T get the promised 500 currency + the data gets lost again. 🫤 UPDATE: Now I can’t even hatch a new egg, because the App just turns grey. Whenever I try to access the old data the screen goes white for an infinite time. So I can neither log in nor create a new one. It’s just completely broken on Iphone ig."
            2. _Sullivan !!!12345_, Oct 11, 2026, 5/5: "So fun my favorite way to get stuff done one thing it glitches when I try it click to fast"
            3. _epicinsomniac_, Aug 13, 2026, 5/5: "I’ve just moved into my own place and I have a whole lot of mental issues that tend to get in the way of me hardly looking after myself. I downloaded this when I moved into my own place a few days ago and so far, I’m checking it every day, knocking off goals and getting to actually do more things for myself than I ever have before while also playing with my pet on here. I already love it even though I was truly sceptical at first."
<!--/ir-theme-->
